$comment: Read by scripts/i18n-translate.mjs (sent with every request) and by native reviewers. keep: never translated. fixed: the approved translation per locale; a locale without one gets the model's translation, checked in review. register: tone per locale.

register.es: Neutral international Spanish, informal "tú". No regionalisms.
register.fr: Standard French, "vous". French typography: a non-breaking space before : ; ? ! and %.
register.de: Standard German, informal "du" as in German software marketing. Compound nouns are fine, but keep buttons short.
register.ja: Polite です/ます style. Full-width Japanese punctuation. No spaces between Japanese words.
register.ko: Polite 합니다/해요 style consistent within a string; 해요체 for UI labels and buttons.
register.zh-Hans: Simplified Chinese for mainland China and Singapore. Full-width punctuation. Call a QR code 二维码.
register.hi: Simple, everyday Hindi in Devanagari. Keep common English tech words (QR code, link, app, download) in English or their usual Hindi transliteration where Indians would.

rules: Translate meaning, not words. Natural marketing copy a native speaker would write, but no new claims: never add a feature, number, promise or adjective the English doesn't make.
Keep every ICU placeholder ({name}, {count, plural, ...}, {x, select, ...}) and every tag (<link>…</link>) exactly, translating only the text inside branches and tags.
Keep product names, brand names, file formats and code identifiers from the keep list in English.
No exclamation marks unless the English has one.
Keep buttons and labels about as short as the English (the length budget is given per string).
